title: Photography Release Checklist
subtitle: Capture image or audio, capture setting, name use, and publication channel; confirm duration and withdrawal.
description: Photography Release records image or audio, capture setting, name use, publication channel, duration, and withdrawal. Photography Release evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this photography release stage-gated verification when staff must document image or audio and capture setting. Reconcile name use, publication channel, duration, and withdrawal before the photography release handoff. Use the production brief, capture list, subject match, permitted-use matrix, channel inventory, editing and attribution instruction, publication record, and withdrawal log. Ask the assigned photography release reviewer to confirm image or audio against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Photography Release contact and reference
sections.guidance: Itemize image, video, audio, name and quotation use; bound capture setting, publication channel, audience, editing, duration, storage, and withdrawal. Record the photography release decision separately from attendance, registration, or routine operations.

sections.title: Photography Release checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current photography release facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Photography Release required checks
items: Image or audio is identified for this record
Capture setting matches the current request or source
Name use is ready for point-of-use staff
Publication channel limits or questions are resolved
Duration is communicated to the responsible person

blocks.label: Photography Release failed or pending items

sections.title: Photography Release readiness and handoff
sections.guidance: Hold photography release readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Photography Release reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Photography Release receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
